correctness.rationale: Counting productive hub/leaf pairs gives P(x±e_i)=x_i/(2s), with s=sum leaf counts; all idle steps can be ignored for absorption probabilities. h(x)=∏x_i is harmonic for the chain, vanishes if any leaf is extinct, and is positive at fully surviving terminals. Doob h-transform gives probabilities (x_i+1)/(2s) up and (x_i−1)/(2s) down. Their total up/down probabilities (s+d)/(2s) and (s−d)/(2s) depend only on s; with t_i=x_i−1, the conditional leaf composition under any realized total-size trajectory is Dirichlet-multinomial with shape 2 for each type: upward steps are Pólya additions of weight t_i+2; downward steps uniformly delete among t_i tokens. At size n, h-transform probability is C∏ell_i, and dividing by h(ell)=∏ell_i gives identical original probability C=(n−d)!(2d−1)!/(n+d−1)!. The chain is finite and a.s. absorbs at an extinction or s=n; under the transform s hits n a.s. Counting positive compositions yields full coexistence and the fixed-d asymptotic and simplex weak limit. Independent exact-rational absorbing-chain solves agree for six small cases, e.g. d=3,n=7 each of 15 compositions 1/126; finite computations corroborate only.

value.rationale: The probability that every peripheral opinion survives is a natural rare-event statistic missing from individual survival estimates. The theorem determines the entire labelled composition law, reveals exact unconditioned uniformity independent of balance, and supplies a sharp n^(-d) coexistence probability and conditional Dirichlet law. This gives a meaningful complete result for a specified natural star compatibility model rather than an arbitrary small sample.

final_claim: In the fair complete-communication EdgeVOG star with d>=2 leaves, n>=d+1 agents initially one per leaf, every positive terminal all-leaf composition ell_1+...+ell_d=n has the same unconditioned probability (n−d)!(2d−1)!/(n+d−1)!. The all-leaf survival probability is binom(n−1,d−1) times this constant; conditioned on all surviving, the counts are uniform and normalized proportions tend to Dirichlet(1,...,1) for fixed d.
limitations: No law for partial survival after any peripheral extinction; no unequal agent rates or other confidence graphs.
Fixed d Dirichlet limit is conditional on rare event; finite checker not a universal proof.
